# Volcano

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano)

Volcano is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `volcano` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { volcano } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-volcano';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, volcano],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `volcano` | `Extension` |
| `volcanoMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#390000` |
| Active line | `#480000` |
| Selection | `#5e0000` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#fc594d` | bold | 5.69:1 | 5.23:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#fc594d` | bold | 5.69:1 | 5.23:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#c27df7` | - | 6.45:1 | 5.94:1 | 5.13:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#e7c0c0` | - | 10.82:1 | 9.96:1 | 8.60:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#fec758` | - | 11.52:1 | 10.60:1 | 9.16:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#fec758` | - | 11.52:1 | 10.60:1 | 9.16:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#7df3f7` | - | 13.66:1 | 12.57:1 | 10.86:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#7df3f7` | - | 13.66:1 | 12.57:1 | 10.86:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#9df39f` | - | 13.42:1 | 12.35:1 | 10.67:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#fec758` | italic | 11.52:1 | 10.60:1 | 9.16:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#7dcaf7` | italic | 9.93:1 | 9.14:1 | 7.90:1 |
| String | `string` | `#fec758` | - | 11.52:1 | 10.60:1 | 9.16:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#f77dca` | - | 7.45:1 | 6.85:1 | 5.92:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#d47b3c` | - | 5.71:1 | 5.25:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#d47b3c` | - | 5.71:1 | 5.25:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#fec758` | - | 11.52:1 | 10.60:1 | 9.16:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#e7c0c0` | italic | 10.82:1 | 9.96:1 | 8.60:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#f8f8f8` | background, active line, selection | 13.40:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#e7c0c0` | gutter | 9.84:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#dd0000` | background, active line | 3.19:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#f95d54` | background | 5.73:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #f95d54` | background, active line | 5.27:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#f95d54, 1px solid #f95d54` | background (fill or outline) | 5.73:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#7500009c` | active line | 1.16:1 | Pass |
